source.title: The Persistence and Transience of Memory.

confidence_rationale: Grounds the 'retired' state as a first-class ADAPTIVE, regulated operation (transience enhances flexibility + prevents overfitting; goal of memory is decision-optimisation not preservation) -- supports MECH-391's retired state. But for INV-080 it is a genuine TENSION: it argues controlled forgetting/attenuation is GOOD, cautioning against a naive 'never delete' reading. Net mixed: it reframes INV-080 as 'retirement must be GOVERNED', not 'no deletion'.
failure_signatures: Transience (forgetting) is adaptive -- it enhances flexibility and prevents overfitting -- so an over-strong INV-080 that forbids ALL deletion would itself be a failure mode (hoarding outdated, overfit detail). The invariant must be read as 'no SILENT/ungoverned deletion of the evidence base', not 'no forgetting'; a memory system that never retires anything degrades decision-making.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Transience (forgetting) is as important as persistence: it (1) enhances flexibility by reducing the influence of outdated information on memory-guided decisions and (2) prevents overfitting to specific past events, promoting generalisation; the goal of memory is to optimise decision-making, not to transmit information faithfully through time.
mapping.ree_translation: Two-sided. For MECH-391: grounds the 'retired' state as a designed, adaptive, REGULATED operation (forgetting is a first-class lifecycle move, not mere decay). For INV-080: a corrective -- the invariant cannot mean 'never delete'; it must mean 'retirement and abstraction must be GOVERNED and provenanced', preserving the evidence base while still permitting principled transience.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is the entry that problematises a naive INV-080. Biology says controlled forgetting is adaptive; an invariant forbidding all deletion would be maladaptive (hoarding overfit detail). So the grounding REFRAMES INV-080 rather than simply supporting it: the rule is about preventing SILENT, ungoverned overwrite/loss of source evidence, not about preventing retirement per se. Mixed, leaning corrective.
mapping.source_context: Neuron review drawing explicit parallels between neurobiological forgetting and computational regularisation / overfitting.

confidence_components.notes: Mixed/corrective: supports the retired state for MECH-391 while sharpening INV-080 away from a naive no-deletion reading.
